sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/2 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/grid for facility 9 Belle Isle Campground and search/details for each of its 28 sites, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/belle-isle ('All sites have electric pedestals, which accept plugs for 20, 30 and 50-amp current'; 'E/W - Electric and water hookups'), read 2026-10-20; reservevaparks.com site details: all 28 sites list Electric Hookup 50 and Water Hookup

values.note: 28 electric/water sites, all site-specific, for tents, pop-ups and RVs up to 45 ft (DCR). On the booking site 7 are pull-through and 21 back-in; its per-site vehicle lengths (36-148 ft) look like pad lengths and were not used for max_rig_ft. Two vehicles per site. A separate hike-in/paddle-in primitive tent campground (Brewers Point, 4 sites) has no vehicle access.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/belle-isle ('RVs up to 45 feet', 'No. of each site type : E/W, 28', 'All campsites are site-specific') + reservevaparks.com search/details per site (PullInTypeName, VehicleLength), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/belle-isle ('Full-service bathhouse with hot showers', 'Laundry facilities are at the campground bathhouse', 'A dump station is free for those camping in the park', 'Camp store: Camping and picnic supplies', 'The Visitor Center has WiFi, but the campground and Bel Air area do not'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reservable online by site (all sites site-specific); the booking site gives a 14-night maximum on each campsite. Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/belle-isle ('Reserve Online', 'All campsites are site-specific', check-in/out times) + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on all 28 sites), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed reservable with a 14-night max and the $37 electric/water rate on the booking site (fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12; season already manual). Added 50-amp electric and water, 28 sites to 45 ft with 7 pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/camp store, no wifi in the campground. Not stated: sewer, booking window or cutoff for this park, first-come policy.
